I answered Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

- **Where it came from:** On 20 Aug 2025 Dana Okafor posted in #north-team that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again, on the morning shift. The same trailer was recorded twice because the driver checked in at the kiosk and dispatch also added him by hand.
- **Our side:** Dana said she was handling it.
- **More support:** Thea was also Dana's contact during the Superior terminal Sev 1 in #inc-qfl-sev1.

I only used channels Ilse is in: #north-team and #inc-qfl-sev1. I left out the seat counts and the amendment from that same thread because they weren't part of her question.
